firstPlayerRule: The youngest player takes the first-player token and starts.
houseFallback: If the youngest players are tied, choose randomly among them.
clarifications: The first player begins the two clockwise small-tree placement circuits during setup.
During each Life Cycle phase, players take their turns clockwise from the first player. Pass the first-player token clockwise at the end of the round.
